metas.name: 1. Kamp Krusty
metas.description: Bart leads an uprising at Krusty's summer camp after he and Lisa are subjected to a Dickensian sweatshop.

metas.name: 2. A Streetcar Named Marge
metas.description: Marge is cast in a version of "A Streetcar Named Desire," playing Blanche to Ned Flanders' Stanley.

metas.name: 3. Homer the Heretic
metas.description: After skipping church one Sunday morning, Homer decides to quit church altogether and spend Sundays worshiping in his own way -- with cigars and beer.

metas.name: 4. Lisa the Beauty Queen
metas.description: Homer enters Lisa into the Little Miss Springfield Pageant to help her feel better about her looks. But when she must choose between the title and her integrity, she realizes that confidence comes from within.

metas.name: 5. Treehouse of Horror III
metas.description: A Halloween trilogy includes a murderous Krusty doll; a "King Kong" parody; an invasion of zombies unleashed by Bart's incantation.

metas.name: 6. Itchy & Scratchy: The Movie
metas.description: Bart is punished by being barred from the Itchy and Scratchy movie.

metas.name: 7. Marge Gets a Job
metas.description: Mr. Burns is instantly smitten when Marge takes a job at the nuclear power plant.

metas.name: 8. New Kid on the Block
metas.description: Bart has a crush on his new neighbor, a teenage girl who only has eyes for Jimbo Jones. Bart sets out to prove that Jimbo is not as tough as he seems.

metas.name: 9. Mr. Plow
metas.description: Homer and Barney become competitors in the snow-plowing business.

metas.name: 10. Lisa's First Word
metas.description: While trying to get Maggie to say her first word, Marge and Homer reminisce about Bart's and Lisa's first words.

metas.name: 11. Homer's Triple Bypass
metas.description: Homer sees a discount doctor for a coronary bypass.

metas.name: 12. Marge vs. the Monorail
metas.description: When Springfield gets a sudden windfall, a charismatic traveling salesman convinces the town to build a monorail.

metas.name: 13. Selma's Choice
metas.description: After seeing Aunt Gladys die alone, Aunt Selma wants to get married and have a baby... until she spends a day babysitting Bart and Lisa at Duff Gardens.

metas.name: 14. Brother from the Same Planet
metas.description: When Homer neglects Bart once too often, Bart goes to the Big Brother program to get a new father figure. Stung, Homer replaces Bart with a little brother.

metas.name: 15. I Love Lisa
metas.description: Chief Wiggum's son has a crush on Lisa after she gives him a Valentine out of pity.

metas.name: 16. Duffless
metas.description: After a DUI, Homer swears off beer for a month. Meanwhile, Bart and Lisa's sibling rivalry plays out in the school science fair.

metas.name: 17. Last Exit to Springfield
metas.description: Union president Homer fights to keep the dental plan.

metas.name: 18. So It's Come to This: A Simpsons Clip Show
metas.description: An April Fools' Day prank provides the jumping-off point for Simpson family flashbacks.

metas.name: 19. The Front
metas.description: Lisa and Bart write an Itchy and Scratchy episode; Homer makes up a missing high-school credit.

metas.name: 20. Whacking Day
metas.description: Lisa takes a stand against Springfield's annual snake-bashing festival.

metas.name: 21. Marge in Chains
metas.description: Overwhelmed by her family's demands during a flu epidemic, Marge accidentally shoplifts at the Kwik-E-Mart and winds up in prison.

metas.name: 22. Krusty Gets Kancelled
metas.description: Krusty's Hollywood pals help when his show is canceled after a new star causes his ratings to plummet.
